configurePresets.name: linux_steamrt4_x86_64
configurePresets.description: Native Linux x86_64 build for Steam Linux Runtime 4.0. Run inside the steamrt4 SDK container (registry.gitlab.steamos.cloud/steamrt/steamrt4/sdk) so the ABI is capped at the runtime baseline. IPO/LTO enabled for smaller depots. SteamPipe deploy scripts are generated into the build tree (CT_STEAMPIPE).

configurePresets.name: windows_msvc_steam_x86_64
configurePresets.description: Windows x86_64 build with MSVC and static CRT (/MT) — no VC++ redistributable dependency in the SteamPipe depot. SteamPipe deploy scripts are generated into the build tree (CT_STEAMPIPE).

configurePresets.name: windows_llvm_mingw_steam_x86_64
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile Windows x86_64 binaries from Linux with LLVM-MinGW, statically linking the C/C++ runtime — the .exe imports only Windows system DLLs. SteamPipe deploy scripts are generated into the build tree (CT_STEAMPIPE).

workflowPresets.name: linux_steamrt4_x86_64_release_package
workflowPresets.description: Configure, build, test, and package a Steam Linux Runtime 4.0 release (ZIP, SteamPipe-ready)
